_comment: Supply-chain pins for the disclosed non-stdlib dependencies. Each entry pins an EXACT version and the sha256 of that release's source distribution (sdist) from PyPI. tests/test_supply_chain_pins.py asserts (a) the pyproject.toml extra pins the same exact version, and (b) when the library is importable, its reported __version__ matches. The sdist sha256 is the provenance anchor recorded here; full per-wheel hash-pinning belongs in a deployment requirements lockfile (documented residual). Feed adoption_date into the Rule S-10 dependency-vetting cooldown before relying on a pin in enforcement.

pins.name: cryptography
pins.sha256_source: pypi.org sdist, downloaded from files.pythonhosted.org and sha256 verified locally 2026-09-28
pins.purpose: Ed25519 asymmetric signing for constraint-relaxing authorizations (exception-governance Workstream B); bumped from 49.0.0 to remediate CVE-2026-69247 / GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5 (PKCS#7 EnvelopedData Bleichenbacher oracle, first patched 50.0.0). agentteams uses only the Ed25519 path, not PKCS#7 — remediated for supply-chain hygiene.
